title: Capitals of Oceania
intro: 10 capital cities of Oceania, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Apia
rounds.fact: Apia is the capital of Samoa.

rounds.name: Tarawa
rounds.fact: Tarawa is the capital of Kiribati.

rounds.name: Majuro
rounds.fact: Majuro is the capital of Marshall Islands.

rounds.name: Funafuti
rounds.fact: Funafuti is the capital of Tuvalu.

rounds.name: Melekeok
rounds.fact: Melekeok is the capital of Palau.

rounds.name: Wellington
rounds.fact: Wellington is the capital of New Zealand.

rounds.name: Port Moresby
rounds.fact: Port Moresby is the capital of Papua New Guinea.

rounds.name: Palikir
rounds.fact: Palikir is the capital of Micronesia (Federated States of).

rounds.name: Nuku'alofa
rounds.fact: Nuku'alofa is the capital of Tonga.

rounds.name: Canberra
rounds.fact: Canberra is the capital of Australia.
